svg.text: MAVIA ERD 3 — LEARNERS, QUESTIONS, AND THE ADAPTIVE RUNTIME
Course membership, one question table for both sources, per-concept mastery, and the decision log the adaptive engine writes
PK = primary key FK = foreign key ? = nullable U = part of a unique constraint

One QUESTION table replaces the previous split between extracted and generated questions; origin says which, and STUDENT RESPONSE needs a single non-null question_id instead of two mutually exclusive ones.
QUESTION TARGET is the many-to-many to learning objects: unique (question, learning_object), plus a partial unique on question where is_primary, so a question has exactly one primary chunk.
CONCEPT MASTERY replaces the concept_mastery JSON blob — unique (learning_state, concept) — so per-concept knowledge can be reported on and aggregated in SQL.
unique (student, course) on both ENROLLMENT and LEARNING STATE. remediation_stack and remediated_positions stay JSON: both are read and written whole, and neither is ever queried by element.
ADAPTIVE CONFIG is a single row holding the Bayesian Knowledge Tracing parameters. Its updated_by_id references USER; the edge is left undrawn so the runtime relationships stay legible.
